# Create intervention_table.csv

## #1 Load Packages

```{r}
library(here)
library(survminer)
library(stringr)
library(survival)
```

## #2 Import Data

```{r}
ITP <- read.csv(here("results","table_ITP_Lifespan_Data.csv"))
```

```{r}
ITP$sex[ITP$sex=="f"]="Female"
ITP$sex[ITP$sex=="m"]="Male"
```

## #3 Intervention Groups

```{r}
treatment_list=unique(ITP$group)
```

## #4 Calculate Kaplan-Meier Median

```{r}
kaplan_meier = survfit(Surv(age, flag_censura) ~ group + sex, data = ITP)

km = surv_median(kaplan_meier)
```

## #5 Create Table

```{r}
intervention_table=data.frame()
```

## #6 Kaplan-Meier

### #6.1 Add Kaplan-Meier Median

```{r}
for (row in 1:nrow(km)){
  
  treatment = str_extract(km$strata[row], "(?<=group=)[^,]+(?=,)")
  sex = str_extract(km$strata[row], "(?<=sex=)[^, ]+")
  n = kaplan_meier$n[row]
  median_value = km$median[row]
  
  intervention_table=rbind(
    intervention_table,
    data.frame(
    Intervention = treatment,
    Sex = sex,
    N = n,
    Median = median_value))
}
```

### #6.2 Add Variation (%)

```{r}
for (row in 1:nrow(km)){
  
  treatment = intervention_table$Intervention[row]
  cohort = unique(ITP$cohort[ITP$group == treatment])
  
  if (cohort == "C2015") {
    control = "Control_C2015" 
  } else if (cohort == "C2016") {
    control = "Control_C2016"
  } else {
    control = "Control_C2017"
  }
  
  sex = intervention_table$Sex[row] 
  
  median_control = intervention_table$Median[intervention_table$Intervention == control & intervention_table$Sex == sex]
  
  variation = round((intervention_table$Median[row] / median_control) * 100, digits = 1)
  intervention_table$Variation[row] = variation
  
}
```

## #7 Log Rank Test

```{r}
intervention_table$P_Value = NA_real_

for (row in 1:nrow(km)){
  
  treatment = intervention_table$Intervention[row]
  
  if (grepl("^Control_", treatment)) next
  
  cohort = unique(ITP$cohort[ITP$group == treatment])
  
  if (cohort == "C2015") {
    control = "Control_C2015" 
  } else if (cohort == "C2016") {
    control = "Control_C2016"
  } else {
    control = "Control_C2017"
  }
  
  sex = intervention_table$Sex[row]
  
  df <- ITP[
    ITP$group %in% c(control, treatment) &
      ITP$cohort == cohort &
      ITP$sex == sex,
  ]
  
  lr = survdiff(
    Surv(age, flag_censura) ~ group,
    data = df
  )
  p = lr$pvalue
  
  intervention_table$P_Value[row] = p
}
```

## #8 Cox Proportional Hazard Model

```{r}
intervention_table$Hazard_Ratio = NA_real_

for (row in 1:nrow(km)){
  
  treatment = intervention_table$Intervention[row]
  
  if (grepl("^Control_", treatment)) next
  
  cohort = unique(ITP$cohort[ITP$group == treatment])
  
  if (cohort == "C2015") {
    control = "Control_C2015" 
  } else if (cohort == "C2016") {
    control = "Control_C2016"
  } else {
    control = "Control_C2017"
  }
  
  sex = intervention_table$Sex[row]
  
  df <- ITP[
    ITP$group %in% c(control, treatment) &
      ITP$cohort == cohort &
      ITP$sex == sex,
  ]
  
  coxmodel = coxph(
    Surv(age, flag_censura) ~ group,
    data = df
  )
  
  hr = exp(coxmodel$coefficients)
  
  intervention_table$Hazard_Ratio[row] = hr
}
```

## #9 Export File

```{r}
write.csv(intervention_table,
          here("experiments", "interventions", "interventions.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```
